sessionTasks.label: Prep
tasks: Set out ~52 airtight bags or deli containers; label each with cookie, session and batch size
Black & White chocolate (Sessions 1 and 7): 3 doubles + 1 single; per double 94 g flour, 20 g Dutch cocoa, 40 g malted milk powder, 2.3 g espresso powder, 4 g baking powder, 1 g salt (single = half)
Black & White vanilla: 3 doubles + 1 single; per double 280 g flour, 100 g malted milk powder, 4 g baking powder, 1 g salt (single = half)
Crinkles (Session 2): 7 × 270 g flour, 10 g baking soda, 3 g ginger, 3 g cinnamon, 1.5 g cloves
Lime Rickey (Session 3): 7 × 250 g flour, 6 g baking powder, 2.4 g baking soda, 3 g salt
Thumbprints (Session 4): grind 40 g freeze-dried cherries; 5 × 270 g flour, 8 g cherry powder, 4 g baking powder, 3 g salt
Bar crusts (Session 5): 7 × 280 g flour, 3 g salt; caramel cups: 3 doubles (4 g salt, 1 g star anise) + 1 single (2 g, 0.5 g)
Wafers (Session 6): 7 × 150 g flour, 45 g Dutch cocoa, 1.2 g baking soda, 2 g salt
Creme (Session 9): 7 × 20 g nonfat milk powder + 1 g salt; leave the popping candy sealed in its bag
Whisk or shake each mix, seal, and store cool and dry, grouped by session
